item.title: Pereira books five-rounder against Pavlovich at UFC 335 in December
item.description: Former two-weight UFC champion Alex Pereira, who is 13-4, will look to rebound from his unsuccessful heavyweight debut against Sergei Pavlovich (21-3) in a five-round co-main event at UFC 335 on Dec. 12 in Las Vegas, officials announced Saturday.

item.title: Prochazka to fight Stirling at UFC Fight Night in Qatar
item.description: Former UFC light heavyweight champion Jirí Procházka will return to action for the second time this year, in a five-round main event at UFC Fight Night on Nov. 21. He will face rising contender Navajo Stirling (11-0) inside ABHA Arena in Doha, Qatar.

item.title: UFC bantamweight Barcelos doing 'great' after hospitalization
